name: La Valle Magica
summary: La Valle Magica is a 2D side-scrolling platform game starring characters from Kinder's line of chilled snacks, and one of four standalone Fresh Adventures games that each consist of a single themed level. Thieves have stolen a secret snack recipe, and Pinguì the penguin and Fetta al Latte travel through a magical valley to recover its six ingredients. You switch between the two heroes at any time: Pinguì jumps far and glides, while Fetta al Latte is strong enough to push obstacles aside. Snowballs freeze the bears and bees in your way, and the level ends in a boss fight against Captain Octopus.
